description: SoCal Robotics & STEM Foundation is a nonprofit supporting robotics teams and STEM education across Southern California. We provide mentorship, tools, and competition support to students who want to design, build, and program real machines — no prior experience required.
meetingTime: Saturdays, 10:00 AM – 1:00 PM at the Innovation Lab
moreText: Want to get involved? Students, mentors, and sponsors are all welcome — come to a Saturday session or reach out below.

events.title: Fall Build Season Kickoff
events.description: First Saturday session of the season — meet your team and get hands-on with this year's kit of parts.

events.title: Regional Qualifier
events.description: Our teams compete for a spot at the state championship.

awards.title: Regional Innovation Award
awards.description: Recognized for our student-designed outreach curriculum.
